title: feat(console): the app's menu is edited in the design mode (#36363)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jSr8sNCnJrK6Q9kEF5

Fixes #36363

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：管理员进入设计模式后，左侧菜单变成可编辑：每个分组底部有「添加菜单项」，点了先在那个位置占一行虚线框，再弹出选择面板（搜索框，按对象、视图、仪表盘、报表、页面、链接分类，只列已经存在、还不在菜单里的）；每一项鼠标移上去右边有「⋮」：上移、下移、移到分组、在前面或后面加一项、改名和图标、从菜单移除；也可以直接拖动。改动都等设计模式的「保存」一起写入并发布，所有成员都能看到；「取消」全部丢掉。安装来的应用（只读包）现在也能进入设计模式，改动存为本环境的定制。保存写的是应用存储的菜单，不是当前用户看到的那份：中文界面下保存不会把中文名写进菜单，管理员看不到的条目也原样保留，只改动管理员动过的那几项。改名只在部署的默认语言下开放（且该项显示名就是存储名），其他语言下名称框禁用并提示「菜单名称需在应用的源语言下修改」；新增、移动、图标在任何语言下都能改。其他包追加进菜单的条目（例如 HotCRM 收入模块的报价、产品）在这里不能移动、改名或移除，「⋮」里会说明要到那个包里改。有未保存的菜单改动时，切到别的应用、关闭或刷新页面会先弹出外壳原有的未保存提示（留在这里 / 放弃并离开），选「留在这里」改动还在；没有改动时照常直接切换。
- 为什么做：维护者要求菜单在运行界面里直接改，不再去 Studio；这是设计模式这条线的第二张卡。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是保存后菜单顺序或条目不是管理员想要的，再进设计模式改回即可；「移除」只是不在菜单显示，东西本身不删；若同一应用在 Studio 里有未发布的草稿，保存会拒绝并说明原因，不会覆盖别人的草稿。
- 要你做什么：无。翻译名称的写入（在非默认语言下改名）和服务端声明应用源语言是后续卡 #36504，本 PR 不做。一处与 ADR-0146 D5 不同的地方已由席位记入修订卡：安装来的应用，管理员页头的入口从「在 Studio 中查看」变成「编辑应用」（进入设计模式），这是本卡第 7 条的要求。这只是过渡：按你新定的 #36485，设计模式入口会移到左上角应用名菜单，页头这两个按钮会去掉，由那张卡来做；本 PR 只改了现有按钮的一个判断，没有新做按钮。

## What changes

While the design mode (#36362) is on, the sidebar draws the app's menu with its editor (`layout/DesignModeMenu.tsx`), instead of the plain menu.

- **Add menu item.** Each group, and the menu's top level, ends with 「Add menu item」. Pressing it holds a dashed row 「Choose a menu item…」 at that place and opens a picker: a search box over every kind, then the kinds Objects, Views, Dashboards, Reports, Pages and Link. A kind lists what exists and is not in the menu yet (`designModeMenu.ts` `targetKeyFor` / `entryForTarget`, one key per thing the menu opens); a record page is never offered. Picking one puts it in the held row.
- **The entry's 「⋮」 menu**: move up, move down, move to group (a submenu of the other groups and the top level), add an item before or after, rename and icon, remove from the menu. Removing takes the entry off the menu only; the picker offers it again.
- **Rename only in the source language** (seat ruling (4) on review 7081226692). The name field of 「Rename and icon」 is open when the session language is the deployment's default (`GET /api/v1/i18n/locales`, the descriptor marked `isDefault`; compared case-insensitively, `en` matching `en-US`) and the entry's shown label equals its stored label. Otherwise it is disabled with the hint 「Menu names are changed in the app's source language」, and only the icon is written. Adding, moving and the icon stay open in every language. The stored labels are taken to be in the default language because the server states no source language of its own: `/i18n/locales` exposes `isDefault` only, not `i18n.sourceLocale`. That gap, and the console's write path for a translation, are follow-up #36504.
- **Another package's entry** (its manifest's `navigationContributions`, appended to the app when it is served, found live on HotCRM) is not in the app's stored menu. Its 「⋮」 says 「Another package adds this item. It is moved, renamed or removed there.」, its move, rename and remove items are disabled, and it is not dragged; adding an item before or after it stays open. No entry is moved past it either: 「Move up」 or 「Move down」 into its place is off, and a drop onto it does nothing (its place is that package's). Such entries close their group when the app is served, so an own entry added or moved at or past them is stored and served before them; the editor draws it there too: the group's 「Add menu item」, 「Add an item after」 on such an entry, 「Move to group」 and a drop on the group's end land before them (L1-e review 7083961269 item 1). An entry's link is not dragged by the browser, and the click a drag ends with opens nothing, so a drop the editor refuses no longer lets the browser open the link as a new document (item 2). The save holds the same rule on its own, so it stands when the editor's stored read failed. Without this, a moved contributed entry would have been written into the app's menu and then served twice (the contribution is appended again, with no de-duplication), and a removed one would silently stay.
- **Drag** moves an entry within its group or to another group (dnd-kit, pointer and keyboard).
- **Staged with the mode.** Every edit is staged under one key (`app-menu:<app>`); 「Save」 writes it, 「Cancel」 drops it. The picker tells what is already in the menu by one key per thing it opens, spelled `kind/name` (`object/crm_lead`, `view/…`); they are compared only with each other and are no cache key.
- **The save writes the stored menu, never the served one** (review 7081226692). The served app is translated for the reader (`translateApp`) and pruned of entries the reader may not open (`filterNav`), so writing it back would store the reader's language on every label and drop what the reader was not shown. The save reads the app as stored (the layered read, `/layers?package=…`, which serves a caller who may write the app its stored version, unpruned and untranslated: `effective ?? code`) and replays the edits on its navigation by entry id (`designModeMenu.ts` `rebaseMenuEdits`): an entry removed is removed; an entry added is put after the entry before it in the edited menu; an entry moved (to another group, or out of the order its group's other entries kept, found as the longest common run per group, so a removal beside an entry does not move it) is taken out and put back after the entry before it; an entry whose own keys changed has only those keys written. Every other stored entry, an entry the reader was never shown included, is the same object. A stored entry is matched to its served copy by id only when both name the same thing (type and target); otherwise, and for a stored entry without an id, by its group, type and target, in order (the editor gives served entries without an id the first free `nav_item_<n>` of what the reader was shown, which a stored entry pruned from the reader can already hold). Nothing the stored menu does not hold is ever written from its served copy: an entry another package contributes, or one that has left the stored menu since it was read, is not moved, patched or written, and takes no part in the order comparison; only an entry the served menu does not hold is an addition, and one whose id a stored entry holds is written under a fresh `nav_item_<n>` (the picker also mints ids against the stored menu). An entry naming no target is left out (`navPayloadOf`, as Studio's nav save).
- **Where the save** (`designModeMenuSave.ts`) writes the app with its new `navigation` is where Studio's menu editing writes it (objectstack#30059, ADR-0146 D2/D3): the app's own package when the server lists it writable, else its paired customization package (asked of the ensure door, which creates it on first use), the body declaring the override at the base's listed version. The base's version is checked before the ensure door is asked, and a pair the server answers not writable is refused before anything is written to it. It is written by the runtime's confirmed-save rule: a draft with the first-write pin (a draft already pending, from Studio say, is refused and said, never overwritten nor published), then publish; a refused publish discards the draft this save wrote. A landed publish refreshes the console's metadata, so the menu re-reads.
- **Installed apps enter the mode** (`ShellPageActions.tsx`): in the read-only (`view`) posture, 「Edit app」 now enters the mode where the customization door takes the caller; where it is walled off (a walled deployment, caller not the platform operator) the eye 「Open APP in Studio」 stays. This is kept, and kept minimal: one condition on the existing header button (about 10 lines), with no new button. The maintainer has since moved the mode's entry to the app-name menu and retired the header's 「Edit app」 and 「Open in Studio」 under #36485 (card comment 7080271489). That later PR owns the installed-app path through the new entry; this PR lands first, so an installed app can enter the mode until then.
- **Leaving with unsaved menu changes asks first** (the card's added requirement, comment 7079728193). Switching app from the app menu, a link out of the app, a reload or a tab close asks first while a menu change is staged; with nothing staged, nothing asks. This is the shell's one unsaved-changes prompt (`chrome/unsavedEdits.ts`: `confirmUnsavedLeave` and the `beforeunload` hold), which the design mode registers for every staged change since #36362. The menu editor stages through the mode, so no code change was needed; the new tests pin it for the menu. That prompt offers two choices: stay, or leave and drop the changes. It has no 「Save」. The comment asks for the shell's prompt where one exists, so no three-button dialog was added.
- **Outside the mode** the menu is as before: no 「Add menu item」, no editor 「⋮」.
- An app whose menu is split in areas keeps its menu unedited in the mode (the picker and the moves work on one menu tree).
- New i18n keys under `designMode.menu` in every hand-written locale, zh-Hant generated.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenu.ts` `rebaseMenuEdits` / `staysInOrder` / `storedKeyer`: the edits replayed on the stored menu.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuSave.ts`: the stored read, the check order, where the write goes, and the pending-draft refusal.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/DesignModeMenu.tsx` `nameOpen` / `contributed`: the rename rule and another package's entries.
4. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ShellPageActions.tsx`: the read-only posture entering the mode, and the wall.

## Tests

- New `layout/__tests__/designModeMenu-36363.test.ts`: move up/down stop at the group's ends; move to a group appends, never into itself; a drop lands before/after by direction; insert clamps; rename and icon patch; one key per thing; ids are unique. Added for the review: a view named without its object is keyed as that object's view (S1); no edit returns the stored menu itself; a removal beside an entry does not move it; a move to another group takes the stored entry there; a group the stored menu lacks puts the entry at the top level's end; an id-less stored entry is matched by its target. Added for review 7082970423: a move beside another package's entry (down past it, it up past one, it to the top) returns the stored menu itself (M1); an entry moved after it left the stored menu is not written back (M1); an added entry whose id a hidden stored entry holds is written under a fresh id, the hidden one kept (S2); a served entry given the id a hidden stored entry holds is matched by its target, so removing it removes it and not the hidden one (S2). All five were red against the previous `designModeMenu.ts`.
- New `layout/__tests__/designModeMenuSave-36363.test.ts`: writable package saved and published; read-only package saved into its customization package declaring the override at the base's version; a base with no version refused before writing; an unlisted package refused; a pending draft not overwritten nor published; a refused publish discards the draft. Added for the review: a base with no version is refused before the ensure door is called (the calls are the layered read alone) (N1); a pair answered not writable is refused before anything is written to it; a move under a zh-CN-translated menu writes the stored English labels and the untouched entries as the same objects; an entry pruned from the reader stays where it was stored; a rename writes the one key it changed; id-less stored entries are matched and written without an id; an entry naming no target is left out (N3); the session language against the default one. Added for review 7082970423: a move beside another package's entry writes none of that package's entries (M1).
- New `layout/__tests__/DesignModeMenu-36363.test.tsx`: 「Add menu item」 per group and the top level, 「⋮」 per entry; 「Move up」 staged and saved; 「Move to group」; the held row and a picker offering only what exists and is not in the menu; search over every kind, no record page; remove and offer again; rename; 「Cancel」 after three edits leaves the menu and writes nothing. Added for comment 7079728193: a moved entry not yet saved makes the app switch ask, staying keeps the move, and leaving goes on and writes nothing; a reload or a tab close is held while the move is unsaved, and released once it is saved; with nothing changed, switching asks nothing. Without the mode's registration, the first two go red. Added for the review: under zh-CN with English the default, the rename's name field is disabled with the hint, and the icon alone is saved, the stored English label kept; in the default language, an entry shown under a label other than its stored one is not renamed; adding and moving stay open under zh-CN; another package's entry says where it is changed and its move, rename and remove are disabled; dropping an entry on another group's end moves it there, dropped on an entry elsewhere it takes that place, and the save writes the result (N4, through `DndContext`'s `onDragEnd`). Added for review 7082970423: 「Move down」 above another package's entry is off and a drop on it does nothing; when the editor's stored read failed on entry (so another package's entry looked movable), moving it still writes none of it (M1). Added for review 7083961269: 「Add menu item」 at the end of a group that ends with another package's entry holds the row, and puts the pick, before it, and the save stores it there; 「Add an item after」 on that entry and 「Move to group」 into its group land before it; a drop on that group's end lands before it; an entry's link has `draggable="false"`, the browser's own drag of it is refused (`dragstart` default prevented), and after a drag refused on another package's entry the click it ends with leaves the address as it was, while a plain click still opens the entry's page. All four were red against the previous `DesignModeMenu.tsx`.
- `ShellPageActions-36111.test.tsx`: a read-only package enters the mode; under the wall it keeps the eye; a writable package under the wall still enters.
- `UnifiedSidebar.favoritesMenu-12427.test.tsx`: outside the mode no 「Add menu item」 and no editor 「⋮」.

## Acceptance notes

- **ADR-0146 D5.** D5 draws the app → Studio bridge for a read-only package as a browse entry (the eye). For a caller the customization door takes, an installed app's 「Edit app」 now enters the design mode instead, as the card's item 7 asks (an installed app's menu is edited as this environment's customization). The seat records the D5 row on the ADR revision card #36086. A member, and a caller behind the wall, see what they saw before.
- **Card item 7 (installed apps enter the mode): this PR delivers it.** On main, HotCRM still shows 「Open in Studio」 because this PR is not merged yet. Once it merges, an installed app such as HotCRM shows 「Edit app」 to a caller the customization door takes, and pressing it enters the mode. Verified live on HotCRM in zh-CN (see Verification).
- **Renames in another language are not offered** (seat ruling (4)). The rule takes the deployment's default language as the app's source language, because the server does not expose `i18n.sourceLocale`. A deployment whose default language differs from the language its apps are authored in would see the name field closed in every language until #36504 adds `sourceLocale` to `/i18n/locales` and a console write path for a translation.
- **Another package's menu entries are read-only here.** Moving or removing them belongs to the contributing package (or a later card for an override of a contribution).
- **Left as they are, from reviews 7082970423 and 7083821939; follow-up #36538.** The seat collected N6 through N9 on follow-up card #36538. N7 (two id-less stored entries naming the same target), N8 (a layered read answering neither `effective` nor `code`) and N9 (another package's group listed in 「Move to group」) are the nits of review 7083821939 and are not changed here. N6: nothing pins the stored version between the save's layered read and its draft write, so a publish by someone else that lands in that window (the length of one request) is overwritten; the first-write pin refuses only a pending draft. N2's other half: while the tenancy posture is still being read, a walled deployment can briefly show 「Edit app」 to a tenant administrator; the posture hook answers `undefined` both while reading and on a deployment that reports none, so closing it there would also close the mode where no wall exists, and the server refuses the save behind a wall either way. N5 (a link's typed label stored as its base label in any language) is on #36504.
- **Where it is saved** is the same document Studio's menu editing saves, so a menu edited here shows in Studio, and the reverse.
- An app whose menu is split in areas is not edited in the mode (its menu is drawn unedited); no such app is in the showcase or HotCRM.
- Not in this PR, as the card says: new dashboard or report (#36364), adding, removing or renaming groups, visibility conditions, personal favorites.
- **The chain stops at this card, with one exception.** The maintainer ruled at 2026-11-22 13:52Z that only the current stage is finished, so #36364 is not started from this chain. At 14:08Z the maintainer approved resuming #36366, as its own PR after this one lands; no branch or PR is open for it yet.
- No docs page describes the runtime menu editing, so no docs change.

## Verification

**HotCRM, zh-CN, at this head** (review 7081226692 item (3)). HotCRM 6.5.0 (`pnpm dev`, a fresh database, `pnpm demo:staff`) on port 4001, this branch's console (Vite) proxied to it, a Chromium context in `zh-CN`, signed in as the seeded admin. `GET /api/v1/i18n/locales` marks `en` default. HotCRM's package `app.objectstack.hotcrm` is listed read-only.
